notes.title: Minor Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
[b]I fixed some bugs regarding the Shards and Solace's Minigame:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shards would spawn as invisible 'ghost shards' inside the Dungeon. I fixed their spawning so this won't happen anymore.
[*]When switching between the StarCow Outfit, the belly and boobs sprites would be visible at the same time. I added a 'reset' to the visuals so this won't happen anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: Greasy and Better Performance Update
notes.content:
[b]The Greasy Starla and Nudist Starla outfits have been added to Savoring Sword![/b] They can be purchased at Akana's shop.

[b]Along with that, 'Better Performance' versions have been added.[/b] If you are running the game with less than 16GB RAM, switching to the Better Performance versions will reduced the image quality by half so the game can run more smoothly.

To do this, simply go to Savoring Sword in your Library, then click Settings > Properties > Betas and select 'betterperformance' from the Beta Participation tab.

[i]~Remember to keep the girls well fed![/i] 🍬
